scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @spectra/api" "npm run dev -w @spectra/web"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd packages/evaluation test && bun run --cwd packages/model-gateway test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/evaluation typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/model-gateway typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/schemas typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
